name: Email to Asana – Interior Design Action Items

parameters.text:
=Analyze the following email and extract any action items, tasks, or to-dos.

From: {{ $json.from }}
Subject: {{ $json.subject }}
Date: {{ $json.date }}

Body:
{{ $json.textPlain || $json.text || $json.html }}

---

Instructions:
1. Carefully read the email above.
2. Identify every action item, task, request, or to-do mentioned.
3. If there are NO action items, respond with EXACTLY: NO_ACTION_ITEMS
4. If there ARE action items, respond with a JSON array where each object has:
   - "title": a short, clear task title (max 100 chars)
   - "description": a detailed description including relevant context from the email
   - "priority": 1 (urgent), 2 (high), 3 (normal), or 4 (low)

Example output when action items exist:
[{"title": "Send fabric samples to client", "description": "Client requested fabric samples for the living room redesign. Email from john@example.com on 2024-01-15.", "priority": 3}]

Respond ONLY with the JSON array or NO_ACTION_ITEMS. No other text.
